# nemau dns zone

Manage DNS zones.

A new zone is not served until you prove that you control its domain. It is
created PENDING_VERIFICATION, with a TXT record to publish at the domain's
current DNS host ("nemau dns zone get" shows it). Once the record is visible,
"nemau dns zone verify" checks it and activates the zone; record sets can only
be written to an active zone.

A `<zone>` argument is the zone's id (a UUID) or its name ("example.com" or
"example.com."). A name is looked up in the zone list and must match exactly
one zone.

## Usage

```
nemau dns zone [command]
```

Alias: `zones`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [create](nemau_dns_zone_create.md) | Create a zone |
| [delete](nemau_dns_zone_delete.md) | Delete a zone |
| [get](nemau_dns_zone_get.md) | Show one zone and, while pending, the record that proves its ownership |
| [list](nemau_dns_zone_list.md) | List the zones |
| [update](nemau_dns_zone_update.md) | Change a zone's description, contact or TTL |
| [verify](nemau_dns_zone_verify.md) | Check the TXT record that proves ownership of a pending zone |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
